examples.name: Static value
examples.description: A read-only key/value row with a plain text value.

examples.name: Underlined pair
examples.description: Add underline for a bottom border divider between pairs; leave it off the last pair, so the list doesn't end on a line.
examples.jsx:
<KeyValueList>
  <KeyValuePair label="Account type" value="Trust" underline />
  <KeyValuePair label="Status" value="Active" />
</KeyValueList>

examples.name: Inline editable with TextField in Inline Edit
examples.description: Pass a TextField with context="inline" in Inline Edit as children, so an edit is confirmed or cancelled. actionPlacement="end" puts Inline Edit's buttons at the end of the value, so the row keeps its height while editing. Give the field an aria-label matching the key.
examples.jsx:
<KeyValueList>
  <KeyValuePair label="Client name" underline>
    <InlineEdit value={name} onConfirm={setName} actionPlacement="end">
      <TextField context="inline" aria-label="Client name" iconAfter={<EditIcon color="subtle" />} />
    </InlineEdit>
  </KeyValuePair>
</KeyValueList>

examples.name: Inline editable with TextArea in Inline Edit
examples.description: Pass a TextArea with context="inline" in Inline Edit for multi-line editing. actionPlacement="end" keeps the buttons at the end of the value, and with autoResize, actionAlignment="start" keeps them level with the first line as the field grows.
examples.jsx:
<KeyValueList>
  <KeyValuePair label="Notes" underline>
    <InlineEdit value={notes} onConfirm={setNotes} actionPlacement="end" actionAlignment="start">
      <TextArea autoResize context="inline" aria-label="Notes" iconAfter={<EditIcon color="subtle" />} />
    </InlineEdit>
  </KeyValuePair>
</KeyValueList>

examples.name: Small size
examples.description: The sm size uses tighter padding and smaller typography.

antiExamples.name: Without a <dl> parent
antiExamples.reason: <dt>/<dd> elements are semantically meaningful only inside a <dl>. Wrap pairs in a KeyValueList.

antiExamples.name: Using for a form layout
antiExamples.reason: Key Value Pair is for compact metadata display, not full form layouts. Use the Form organism with Field molecules for forms.
